itens.resumo: No artigo de hoje discutiremos algumas das listas de Commander mais divertidas que achamos em Reality Fracture!

Reality Fracture features 86 new possible Commanders spread across the Multiverse Reforged Commander Precon and the main set. That’s a massive amount of new options, but which ones are the ones spiking our interest? Here are five of the coolest Commanders in Reality Fracture…
